claims.claim: The person whose estate may require probate has died.
claims.quote: Find out if you need to apply for probate to deal with the estate of someone who’s died.
claims.note: The source connects probate to a deceased person’s estate.

claims.claim: The deceased person left assets held in their sole name.
claims.quote: Probate is the legal right to deal with someone’s property, money and possessions (their ‘estate’) when they die.
claims.note: The source discusses estate assets but does not state that they must be held in the deceased person’s sole name.
